leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a CSS Grid layout using the repeat() function with auto-fit
Configure responsive grid columns that adjust automatically to container width
Apply the minmax() function to define flexible column size constraints
Construct grid layouts that maintain minimum column widths while expanding to fill available space
Manipulate grid column behavior by combining auto-fit with minmax() parameters
Update existing grid layouts to incorporate responsive auto-fit functionality
Control grid item distribution across varying viewport sizes using auto-fit and minmax()
